blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Jev is a "System One" model that returns a choice among given options instead of generating text. We study how such a specialized decision model compares with general-purpose large language models (LLMs). We evaluate Jev on 13 multiple-choice benchmarks covering knowledge, reasoning, and multilingual understanding, and compare it with 19 LLMs in three tiers: frontier, representative, and small. Jev is competitive with frontier LLMs on knowledge and commonsense benchmarks and obtains the best score on MMLU-Redux and ARC-Challenge. Outside mathematics, it also outperforms most representative LLMs and all small LLMs. However, it falls behind on mathematical word problems: on MathQA, it is 17.7 points below the frontier median and scores lower than all 19 LLMs. These results indicate that a specialized decision model can match general-purpose LLMs on decisions that rely mainly on knowledge, but not on decisions that require multi-step calculation.
blocks.zh: Jev是一个"System One"模型,它返回给定选项中的选择,而不是生成文本. 我们研究这种专门决策模式如何与通用大语言模式(LLMs)相比较。 我们评价Jev的13个多重选择基准,包括知识、推理和多语种理解,并将其与19个法学硕士进行三级比较:前沿、代表性和小型。 Jev在知识和常识基准方面与前沿LLMs具有竞争力,并在MMLU-Redux和ARC-Challenge上获得最佳得分. 在数学之外,它的表现也超过了最具代表性的LLM和所有的小型LLM. 然而,它落后于数学词问题:在MathQA上,它比边框中位数低17.7分,得分低于所有19个LLMs. 这些结果表明,专门决策模式能够与主要依赖知识、但并不依赖需要多步骤计算的决定的通用有限责任项目相匹配。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across a wide range of language understanding and reasoning tasks ( OpenAI, 2026a ; DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . Beyond generating text, they are increasingly used to make decisions in applications such as question answering, text classification, information verification, and AI agents. Many of these decisions involve choosing an answer or action from a predefined set of options. Although general-purpose LLMs can handle such tasks effectively, their broad capabilities are not always required by the application. This motivates an important question: to what extent can specialized decision models match general-purpose LLMs on tasks with finite answer spaces, and where do their capabilities begin to diverge?
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在广泛的语言理解和推理任务上取得了强效表现(OpenAI,2026a;DeepSeek-AI,2024;Yang等,2025.). 除了生成文本外,它们还越来越多地用于在回答问题、文本分类、信息核实和AI代理等应用程序中作出决定。 其中许多决定涉及从预先确定的一套选项中选择一个答案或行动。 虽然通用有限责任公司能够有效地处理这些任务,但其广泛能力并非总能得到应用。 这引发了一个重要问题:专业决策模式在多大程度上能够与关于有限答案空间任务的通用有限责任方案相匹配,它们的能力开始出现差异?

blocks.en: Jev, developed by TypeSafe AI, provides an opportunity to investigate this question. It is a specialized “System One” model designed to make structured decisions rather than generate open-ended text ( TypeSafe AI, 2026a ) . Given an input and a set of candidate options, Jev directly selects an answer and returns a probability distribution over the options. Since its release, several studies have explored its performance in text classification, routing, medical and legal applications, model evaluation, and scientific decision making ( Deußer et al., 2026 ; Madrid-García and Merino-Barbancho, 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Wang and Gao, 2026 ; Deng et al., 2026 ) . These studies provide initial evidence of Jev’s effectiveness in specific settings. However, its broader capability profile remains insufficiently understood. In particular, previous evaluations either focus on individual applications or include a limited range of comparison models. Even the most comprehensive existing study, which evaluates 37 datasets, compares Jev with only two open-weight LLMs ( Deußer et al., 2026 ) . As a result, it remains unclear how Jev compares with LLMs at different capability levels, and whether its relative performance changes across tasks requiring different types of knowledge and reasoning.
blocks.zh: 由TypeSafe AI开发的Jev提供了一个调查这个问题的机会. 这是一种专门的“系统一”模式,旨在作出有条理的决定,而不是产生开放式文本(TypeSafe AI, 2026a.)。 考虑到一个输入和一组候选选项,Jev直接选择一个答案并返回一个概率分布在选项上. 自发布以来,多起研究探索了其在文字分类,路由,医学和法律应用,模型评价,以及科学决策等方面的表现(Deußer等,2026;Madrid-García和Merino-Barbancho等,2026;张等,2026;李等,2026;王等,2026;邓等,2026). 这些研究为Jev在特定环境下的有效性提供了初步证据. 然而,对其更广泛的能力概况仍然认识不足。 特别是,以前的评价要么侧重于个别应用,要么包括有限的比较模型。 即使是评价了37个数据集的最全面的现有研究,Jev也只比较了两个开放重量的LLMs(Deußer等,2026.). 因此,仍不清楚Jev如何在不同的能力级别上与LLMS进行比较,以及它的相对业绩是否因需要不同种类知识和推理的任务而发生变化.

blocks.en: In this work, we conduct a systematic empirical evaluation of Jev against general-purpose LLMs on standard multiple-choice benchmarks. We evaluate 13 benchmarks covering general knowledge, commonsense reasoning, scientific question answering, mathematical reasoning, and multilingual understanding (Table 1 ). To provide a broad comparison, we include 19 LLMs organized into three tiers: current frontier models, representative models from earlier generations, and small models with fewer than 10B parameters (Figure 1 ). All models are evaluated within a finite-answer setting, allowing us to examine their ability to select correct answers under the same candidate constraints. Rather than focusing only on overall accuracy, we investigate how Jev’s relative performance varies across benchmarks with different task demands.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们根据标准的多选择基准,对照通用法学硕士对Jev进行系统的经验性评价。 我们评价13个基准,包括一般知识、常识推理、科学问题回答、数学推理和多语种理解(表1)。 为了进行广泛的比较,我们包括19个LLMs,它们分为三个层次:目前的前沿模型、早期的代表性模型、以及小于10B参数的小型模型(图1)。 所有模型都在一个有限的答案框架内进行评估,使我们能够审查它们在相同的候选限制下选择正确答案的能力。 我们不只关注总体准确性,

blocks.en: Our results show that Jev exhibits a distinctive capability profile. It performs competitively with general-purpose LLMs on several knowledge-intensive and commonsense benchmarks, achieving the highest accuracy among the evaluated models on MMLU-Redux and ARC-Challenge. It also approaches frontier-level performance on MMLU, WinoGrande, and TruthfulQA. However, this competitiveness does not extend uniformly to all tasks. Jev performs substantially worse on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, falling 17.7 percentage points below the frontier-model median on MathQA and ranking behind all 19 comparison models. These findings suggest that specialized decision models can be effective alternatives to general-purpose LLMs for some constrained decision tasks, but their effectiveness depends strongly on the capabilities required by the task. In particular, selecting from a fixed set of answers does not necessarily make a task easy: some decisions still require substantial calculation and multi-step reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,Jev表现出了独特的能力特征。 它在几个知识密集型和常识性基准上与通用法学硕士进行竞争,在MMLU-Redux和ARC-Challenge上的评价模型中达到最高的准确度。 它还处理MMLU、WinoGrande和TrealfulQA的前沿业绩。 然而,这种竞争力并不统一适用于所有任务。 Jev在数学推理基准方面表现更差,比MathQA上的前沿模型中位数低了17.7个百分点,并排在所有19个比较模型后. 这些研究结果表明,专业决策模式对于某些受限制的决策任务来说,可以成为通用有限责任管理办法的有效替代品,但其效力在很大程度上取决于任务所要求的能力。 特别是,从一套固定的答案中选择并不一定容易完成任务:一些决定仍然需要大量计算和多步骤推理.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We investigate the capability boundary between specialized decision models and general-purpose LLMs in finite-answer tasks, using Jev as a representative case study. • We systematically compare Jev with 19 LLMs across three capability tiers on 13 standard benchmarks, revealing its strengths and limitations across knowledge, commonsense, mathematical reasoning, and multilingual understanding. • We identify task-dependent performance differences that provide empirical evidence for selecting between specialized decision models and general-purpose LLMs in future decision-making systems.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们利用Jev作为具有代表性的案例研究,在有限回答任务中调查专门决定模型与通用有限责任公司之间的能力界限。 我们系统地将Jev与19个LLMs进行比较,涉及13个标准基准的3个能力级别,揭示了它在整个知识、常识、数学推理和多语种理解方面的长处和局限性。 我们查明了依赖任务的业绩差异,这些差异为今后决策系统在专门决策模式和一般用途有限责任方案之间作出选择提供了经验证据。

blocks.en: We investigate the capability boundary between specialized decision models and general-purpose LLMs in finite-answer tasks, using Jev as a representative case study.
blocks.zh: 我们利用Jev作为代表性案例研究,在有限答复任务中调查专门决定模型和通用有限责任公司之间的能力界限。

blocks.en: We systematically compare Jev with 19 LLMs across three capability tiers on 13 standard benchmarks, revealing its strengths and limitations across knowledge, commonsense, mathematical reasoning, and multilingual understanding.
blocks.zh: 在13个标准基准上,我们系统地将Jev与19个LLMS进行三层能力比较,揭示了它在整个知识、常识、数学推理和多语种理解方面的长处和局限性。

blocks.en: We identify task-dependent performance differences that provide empirical evidence for selecting between specialized decision models and general-purpose LLMs in future decision-making systems.
blocks.zh: 我们查明了依赖任务的业绩差异,这些差异为今后决策系统在专门决策模式和一般用途有限责任方案之间作出选择提供了经验证据。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Multiple-choice benchmarks are the standard tools for measuring the knowledge and commonsense of LLMs. They include MMLU, ARC, and HellaSwag ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Clark et al., 2018 ; Zellers et al., 2019 ) and harder or cleaner successors such as MMLU-Pro, MMLU-Redux, and GPQA ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Gema et al., 2025 ; Rein et al., 2023 ) . C-Eval and the multilingual extensions of MMLU cover other languages ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Xuan et al., 2025 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) . We use these benchmarks unchanged and apply them to a new type of model, a specialized decision model.
blocks.zh: 多重选择基准是衡量法学硕士知识和常识的标准工具。 其中包括MMLU, ARC,和HelaSwag(Hendrycks等,2021年;Clark等,2018年;Zellers等,2019年)以及MMLU-Pro,MMLU-Redux等更硬或更清洁的接班人和GPQA(Wang等,2024年;Gema等,2025年;Rein等,2023年). C-Eval和MMLU的多语种扩展涵盖其他语言(Huang等,2023年;Xuan等,2025年;OpenAI,2024年). 我们不加修改地使用这些基准,并将其应用于一种新的模式,一种专门的决策模式。

blocks.en: Jev answers typed questions about a given input. Choice selects one of up to 255 options, Score places the input on an ordered rubric, and Noul returns the probability of a yes/no statement ( TypeSafe AI, 2026a ; Deußer et al., 2026 ) . Its documentation lists arithmetic, counting, and multi-hop instructions as known weaknesses ( TypeSafe AI, 2026b ) . Jev has been evaluated on classification and routing ( Deußer et al., 2026 ) , medicine ( Madrid-García and Merino-Barbancho, 2026 ) , legal documents ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , judging ( Li et al., 2026 ; Wang and Gao, 2026 ) , scientific decisions ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , and social-science annotation ( Ibrahim and Zaki, 2026 ) . Other work studies its sensitivity to option names ( Sun and Xu, 2026 ) and its application ecosystem ( Ling et al., 2026 ) . These studies address specific applications or compare Jev with only a few models, whereas we compare it with three tiers of general-purpose LLMs on standard benchmarks.
blocks.zh: Jev 解答了输入的问题 。 选择在最多255个选项中选择其中之一,得分将输入放入被命令的标题上,而努尔返回是/否声明的概率(TypeSafe AI,2026a; Deußer等, 2026 (英语). 它的文档将算术,计数,多跳指令列为已知的弱点(TypeSafe AI, 2026b.). Jev接受了分类和路线(Deußer等,2026年),医学(马德里-加尔西亚和Merino-Barbancho,2026年),法律文件的评价. (张等,2026年),评事(李等,2026年;王和高等,2026年),科学决策(邓等,2026年),社会科学注释(易卜拉欣和扎基,2026年). 其他工作研究其对选项名的敏感性(Sun and Xu, 2026)及其应用生态系统(Ling等人, 2026). 这些研究涉及具体的应用或将Jev只与少数模型进行比较,而我们则将其与标准基准方面的三层通用法学硕士比较。

blocks.en: General-purpose LLMs are increasingly used for text classification and annotation ( Gilardi et al., 2023 ) . However, on text classification, smaller models fine-tuned for the task often still outperform zero-shot LLMs ( Bucher and Martini, 2024 ) . Model routing and cascades exploit such differences by sending each query to the cheapest model likely to answer it well ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Ding et al., 2024 ; Ong et al., 2024 ) . These methods choose among general-purpose LLMs of different sizes. We study a different kind of component, a specialized decision model, and examine which constrained decisions it can take over.
blocks.zh: 普通用途 LLMs越来越多地用于文字分类和注释(Gilardi等人,2023年)。 然而,在文本分类上,对任务进行微调的更小的模型往往仍然优于零镜头LLMs(Bucher and Martini, 2024.). 模型的路由和级联利用这种差异,将每个查询发送到最便宜的、可能妥善回答的模型(Chen等,2023;Ding等,2024;Ong等,2024)。 这些方法选择不同规模的通用法学硕士。 我们研究一种不同的部分,一种专门的决定模式,并审查哪些限制它的决定可以接管。

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We use 13 multiple-choice benchmarks in three categories (Table 1 ). The knowledge category contains eight benchmarks. MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) tests academic knowledge in 57 subjects. MMLU-Redux ( Gema et al., 2025 ) is a re-annotated subset of MMLU with corrected labels. MMLU-Pro ( Wang et al., 2024 ) makes MMLU harder with ten options and more reasoning-focused questions. GPQA Diamond ( Rein et al., 2023 ) contains graduate-level science questions written by domain experts. C-Eval ( Huang et al., 2023 ) covers 52 disciplines in Chinese. HellaSwag ( Zellers et al., 2019 ) asks for the most plausible continuation of a context. WinoGrande ( Sakaguchi et al., 2020 ) requires commonsense to resolve an ambiguous reference. TruthfulQA ( Lin et al., 2022 ) contains questions that people often answer wrongly because of common misconceptions. The reasoning category contains three benchmarks. ARC-Challenge ( Clark et al., 2018 ) consists of grade-school science questions that retrieval-based methods fail to answer. MathQA ( Amini et al., 2019 ) and AQuA-RAT ( Ling et al., 2017 ) consist of math word problems that require multi-step calculation. The multilingual category contains MMLU-ProX ( Xuan et al., 2025 ) and MMMLU ( OpenAI, 2024 ) , which translate MMLU-Pro and MMLU into 29 and 14 languages, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三类13项多选择基准(表1)。 知识类别包括8个基准。 MMLU (Hendrycks等, 2021) 测试57个学科的学术知识. MMLU-Redux(Gema等,2025年)是MMLU的一个重新附加说明的子集,有被更正的标签. MMLU-Pro (Wang et al., 2024)使MMLU更加困难,有十种选择和更注重推理的问题. GPQA Diamond(Rein等,2023年)包含由领域专家撰写的研究生科学问题. C-Eval (Huang等,2023.)涵盖52个中文学科. HelaSwag(Zellers等人,2019年)要求将一个上下文进行最可信的延续. WinoGrande (Sakaguchi等,2020年) 需要通识才能解决模棱两可的引用. TruthfulQA (Lin等, 2022) 包含了人们经常因常见的误解而错误回答的问题. 推理类包含三个基准. ARC-Challenge (Clark等, 2018)由年级科学问题组成,基于检索的方法无法回答. MathQA (Amini等, 2019年)和AQuA-RAT (Ling等, 2017年) 由需要多步骤计算的数学词问题组成. 多语种类别包括MMLU-ProX(Xuan等,2025年)和MMMLU(OpenAI,2024年),将MMLU-Pro和MMLU分别翻译成29和14种语言.

blocks.en: We compare Jev with 19 LLMs in three tiers. Frontier LLMs are recently released models: GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Qwen3.8-Flash, Qwen3.8-Max, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Representative LLMs are widely used earlier models: GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3-32B, Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, and Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct. Small LLMs have fewer than 10B parameters: Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-4B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Phi-4-mini-instruct, Gemma-3-4B-IT, and Mistral-7B-v0.3.
blocks.zh: 我们把Jev比作19个LLMs,分为三级. Frontier LLMS是最近发布的型号:GPT-5.6 Sol,克洛德·奥普斯 5.5,双子座 3.8 Flash,Qune3.8-Flash,Qune3.8-Max,和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. 代表性LLMS被广泛使用早期的型号有:GPT-4o,克洛德·3.5 Sonnet,DeepSeek-R1,DeepSeek-V3,Qune3-32B,Qune2.5-72B-Instruct,和Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct. 小LLMs的参数少于10B:Qune3-8B,Qune3-4B,Llama-3.1-8B-struct,Phi-4-mini-struct,Gemma-3-4B-IT和Mistral-7B-v0.3.

blocks.en: We follow the standard evaluation split of each benchmark and report accuracy (%). For each item, Jev receives the question and the candidate answers as a single Choice request, and its selected option is taken as the prediction. We evaluate Jev and the frontier LLMs ourselves, each with a single run. On GPQA Diamond, the scores of three frontier LLMs are taken from vendor reports and marked as such. The 13 representative and small LLMs and the 13 benchmarks form 169 model–benchmark pairs. For 104 of them, we use scores published by model developers or independent evaluators, and we evaluate the other 65 ourselves. Published scores differ in prompts, few-shot examples, and reasoning settings, so we use them only for rough comparison. Appendix C gives the source of each one. To compare Jev with the frontier tier on a single benchmark, we use the median score of the six frontier LLMs. Appendix A gives further details.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循每个基准的标准评价划分和报告准确性(%)。 对于每个项目,Jev作为单一选择请求收到问题和候选答案,其选定的选项被作为预测. 我们自己评估Jev和边疆LLMS, 各自有一个跑步。 在GPQA Diamond上,三个前沿有限责任公司的分数取自供应商报告并以此作标记。 13个具有代表性的小型有限责任公司和13个基准构成169个模型-基准对。 对于其中的104个,我们使用模型开发者或独立评估者公布的分数,我们自己评价其他65个. 公布的分数在提示,少镜头的例子和推理设置上有所不同,所以我们只用来作粗略的比较. 附 录 C给出了每一个的来源. 为了在单一基准上比较Jev与前沿层级,我们使用六个前沿法学硕士的中位分. 附 录 A提供了进一步的细节。

blocks.en: 3.2 Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 结果

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the accuracy of Jev and the 19 LLMs, and Figure 2 shows the difference between Jev and the frontier median on each benchmark. We discuss five contrasts that stand out in these results.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Difference between Jev and the frontier median on each benchmark. Gray bands show the range of the six frontier LLMs. ∗ On GPQA Diamond, the median and range cover only the three frontier LLMs evaluated in this work.
blocks.zh: 图 2: Jev与每个基准的边框中位数之间的差异。 * 在GPQA Diamond上,中值和射程仅涵盖本作中评价的三个前沿LLM。

blocks.en: Jev is competitive with frontier LLMs on knowledge and commonsense benchmarks but falls behind them on math word problems. It obtains the best score among all models on MMLU-Redux and ARC-Challenge. On TruthfulQA, WinoGrande, and MMLU, it is above the frontier median or within about one point of it. However, it scores below all six frontier LLMs on both MathQA and AQuA-RAT, and it trails their median by 17.7 points on MathQA. This contrast reflects the different demands of the two kinds of tasks. A knowledge or commonsense question can be answered by identifying the correct option among the candidates. A math word problem requires several calculation steps before an option can be chosen. A plausible explanation is that general-purpose LLMs can work through these steps in generated text, whereas Jev selects an option directly. Consistent with this, the developer of Jev lists arithmetic among its known weaknesses ( TypeSafe AI, 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: Jev在知识和常识基准方面与前沿LLMs具有竞争力,但在数学字数问题上却落后于它们。 它在MMLU-Redux和ARC-Challenge上获得所有型号中的最佳分数. 在"真理QA","WinoGrande"和"MMLU"上,它位于边界中位数上方或其中约一分之内. 然而,它在MathQA和AQuA-RAT上都得分低于所有六个前沿LLMs,在MathQA上,它追逐他们的中位数17.7分. 这种对比反映了两种任务的不同要求. 知识或常识问题可以通过在候选人中确定正确的选择来回答。 数学词问题需要几个计算步骤才能选择一个选项. 一个合理的解释是,通用的LLMS可以在生成的文本中通过这些步骤工作,而Jev直接选择一个选项. 与此相符合,Jev的开发者在其已知的弱点中列出了算术(TypeSafe AI,2026b.).

blocks.en: Outside math, Jev is ahead of the representative and small LLMs in almost every comparison, yet all 13 of them outperform it on MathQA. It is ahead of the representative LLMs in 68 of 76 such comparisons, with the largest margins on GPQA Diamond and MMLU-ProX. Against the small LLMs, it is ahead in all 62 such comparisons, mostly by a wide margin. On AQuA-RAT, six representative LLMs and Qwen3-8B also outperform Jev. Even Mistral-7B-v0.3, which is at least 13 points behind Jev on every other benchmark, is slightly ahead on MathQA. Most of our benchmarks test knowledge, so the lead outside math suggests that Jev covers more knowledge than the earlier generation of LLMs. Small models have limited capacity to store knowledge, which explains their large gap to Jev. The lead of both groups on math may come from working through the calculation before answering. This again suggests that the weakness of Jev lies in multi-step calculation rather than in knowledge. Even a small general-purpose model can solve math word problems that Jev cannot.
blocks.zh: 在数学之外,Jev几乎在每一项比较中都领先于代表性和小LLM,然而在MathQA上,所有13个LLM都超过了它. 在76个此类比较中,它比有代表性的有限责任公司领先68个,其中GPQA钻石和MMLU-ProX的差值最大。 与小型有限责任公司相比,这在所有62个此类比较中都领先,主要是大相径庭。 在AQuA-RAT上,有6个有代表性的LLMs和Qune3-8B也优于Jev. 就连Mistral-7B-v0.3在所有其他基准上都比Jev落后了至少13分,在MathQA上也略为领先. 我们的大多数基准测试知识,所以外部的领先数学表明,Jev覆盖的知识比早期的LLMS要多. 小模型存储知识的能力有限,这解释了它们与Jev的巨大差距. 两个小组在数学方面的领先可能来自于在回答前通过计算工作. 这再次说明Jev的弱点在于多步骤计算而不是知识. 甚至一个小的通用模型也能解决Jev无法解决的数学词问题.

blocks.en: The gap between Jev and the frontier median grows as a benchmark demands more calculation and multi-step reasoning. It is small on MMLU, moderate on MMLU-Pro, and large on GPQA Diamond, AQuA-RAT, and MathQA. On the graduate-level questions of GPQA Diamond, Jev scores about the same as Claude Opus 5.5 but well below the other frontier LLMs. The MMLU family shows this trend most clearly, because MMLU-Pro covers subjects similar to those of MMLU but contains more reasoning-focused questions. Wang et al. (2024) report that chain-of-thought prompting ( Wei et al., 2022 ) improves GPT-4o by 1.5 points on MMLU but by 19.1 points on MMLU-Pro, so intermediate reasoning matters far more on MMLU-Pro. Consistent with this difference, Jev is 1.2 points below the frontier median on MMLU but 5.8 points below it on MMLU-Pro. The same pattern appears when Jev is used as a judge ( Li et al., 2026 ) and in medicine ( Madrid-García and Merino-Barbancho, 2026 ) . Among the representative LLMs, the strongest is DeepSeek-R1, which is slightly ahead of Jev on average (Table 5 ). Besides the two math benchmarks, it leads Jev on MMLU-Pro, C-Eval, HellaSwag, and MMMLU. As a reasoning model, it works through every question before answering, which may explain its lead on the reasoning-focused MMLU-Pro. The gaps on C-Eval and HellaSwag have other causes, which we discuss below.
blocks.zh: Jev与边疆中位数之间的差距随着基准的增长而增加,需要更多的计算和多步骤推理. 它在MMLU上是小的,在MMLU-Pro上是中性的,在GPQA Diamond,AQuA-RAT和MathQA上是大的. 关于GPQA Diamond的研究生级问题,Jev的得分与克洛德·奥普斯·5.5大致相同,但远低于其他前沿LLM. MMLU家族最清楚地表明了这一趋势,因为MMLU-Pro涵盖与MMLU类似的主题,但包含更注重推理的问题. 王等编. (2024年)报告说,思维链提示(Wei等,2022年)使GPT-4o在MMLU上改进了1.5分,但在MMLU-Pro上改进了19.1分,因此中间推理在MMLU-Pro上更为重要。 与这一差异一致,Jev在MMLU上比边中位数低1.2分,而在MMLU-Pro上比它低5.8分。 当Jev作为法官(Li等,2026年)和医学(Madrid-García和Merino-Barbancho,2026年)使用时,也会出现同样的模式. 在有代表性的LLMs中,最强的是DeepSeek-R1,平均略高于Jev(表5)。 除了两个数学基准,它还带领Jev在MMLU-Pro,C-Eval,HelaSwag,和MMMLU上. 作为一个推理模型,它先通过每一个问题再回答,这可以解释它在以推理为重点的MMLU-Pro上的领先地位. C-Eval和HelaSwag的漏洞还有其他原因,我们将在下文讨论。

blocks.en: Jev transfers well to translated questions but falls behind on questions from Chinese exams. From MMLU to its multilingual version MMMLU, the accuracy of Jev drops by about six points, a decrease similar to those of GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5. On MMLU-ProX, it is about one point below the frontier median and above all representative and small LLMs. Both benchmarks consist of translated questions, so they test whether the same knowledge can be used in other languages. For Jev, it largely can. C-Eval shows a different result: Jev is about eight points below the frontier median and behind all representative LLMs from Chinese developers. C-Eval is built from Chinese exams rather than translated questions, so it requires knowledge specific to the Chinese curriculum. Models from Chinese developers likely cover this knowledge better.
blocks.zh: Jev转好为翻译题,但中国考试题落后. 从MMLU到其多语种版本MMLU,Jev的精度下降约6分,与GPT-5.6 Sol和克洛德·奥普斯5.5的精度下降相类似. 在MMLU-ProX上,它大约低于边界中位数的一分,最重要的是有代表性的和小型的LLMs. 这两个基准都由被翻译出的问题组成,因此它们检验同样的知识是否能够被用在其他语言中. 对于Jev来说,它基本上可以。 C-Eval显示不同的结果: Jev位于边疆中位数下约8分,以及中国开发商所有有代表性的LLMs后方. C-Eval由中文考试而非翻译问题而来,因此需要中文课程特有的知识. 中国开发商的模型可能更能覆盖这一知识。

blocks.en: Table 3: Accuracy (%) of Jev in this work and in Deußer et al. (2026) , with the number of items in their evaluation. Our ARC score is on ARC-Challenge; theirs is on ARC-Easy and ARC-Challenge.
blocks.zh: 表3:在这项工作和Deußer等人(2026年)中,Jev的准确性(%),评价中的项目数量。 我们的ARC得分在ARC-Challenge上;他们的得分在ARC-Easy和ARC-Challenge上.

blocks.en: Our scores for Jev agree closely with those of an independent evaluation, except on HellaSwag. Five of our benchmarks are also used by Deußer et al. (2026) , which lets us compare the two sets of scores (Table 3 ). The two evaluations agree within 0.5 points on MMLU and WinoGrande and within 1.4 points on C-Eval. Their ARC score, which also covers the easier ARC-Easy set, is slightly higher than our score on ARC-Challenge. On HellaSwag, our score is 6.2 points lower. The most likely cause is that the two evaluations use different request templates: Jev is known to be sensitive to how the options are presented ( TypeSafe AI, 2026b ; Sun and Xu, 2026 ) . The gap on HellaSwag in Figure 2 may therefore partly reflect our template.
blocks.zh: Jev的得分与独立评估的得分非常一致,除了HelaSwag。 我们的5个基准也被Deußer等人(2026年)使用,这让我们可以比较两套分数(表3.). 两项评价在MMLU和WinoGrande的0.5分和C-Eval的1.4分之间达成一致。 他们的ARC分数也涵盖比较容易的ARC-Easy分数,略高于我们在ARC-Challenge分数. 在赫拉斯瓦格,我们的得分低了6.2分. 最可能的原因是,这两项评价使用不同的请求模板: Jev已知对选项的呈现方式很敏感(TypeSafe AI, 2026b; Sun and Xu, 2026.). 因此,图2中HelaSwag的空白部分反映了我们的模板。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We evaluated Jev, a specialized decision model, against 19 general-purpose LLMs in three tiers on 13 multiple-choice benchmarks. Jev is competitive with frontier LLMs on knowledge and commonsense benchmarks and outperforms most representative LLMs and all small LLMs there. However, it falls behind on mathematical word problems and scores below all 19 LLMs on MathQA. These results suggest that a specialized decision model can handle many constrained decisions on its own, while decisions that require multi-step calculation still call for a general-purpose LLM. In future work, we will evaluate all tiers under one protocol. We will also study whether the option probabilities of Jev can indicate when a question should be passed to a reasoning model.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了Jev这一专门决策模式,比照13个多重选择基准的分三级的19个通用有限责任公司。 Jev在知识和常识基准方面与边疆法学硕士具有竞争力,并且优于最有代表性的法学硕士和那里的所有小型法学硕士。 然而,它在数学词问题上落后,在数学QA上得分低于所有19个LLMs. 这些结果表明,专门的决策模式可以自行处理许多受限制的决定,而需要多步骤计算的决定仍要求采用通用的LLM。 在今后的工作中,我们将根据一项议定书评估所有级别。 我们还将研究Jev的选项概率是否能够说明一个问题何时应该被转到推理模型.
